methodology.calibration: the shared native iteration count is derived from the faster Tungsten/GMP pilot so both lanes reach the requested window; Python, Rust, and Odin are calibrated independently; native harness warms both implementations before timing
methodology.capacity_selection: smallest sufficient retained capacity; hot handoff wins only within its smallest available size class
methodology.capacity_trace: ascending/descending sweeps, uniform and logarithmic sizes, local +1 growth, doubled results, and small-value-heavy traffic
methodology.cmp_operands: equal except the lowest limb, forcing a full-length scan
methodology.division_shape: 2N-limb positive dividend by N-limb positive divisor
methodology.gmp: two alternating mpz result destinations retain capacity
methodology.odin: two alternating mutable core:math/big destinations retain capacity, matching the library's idiomatic API
methodology.powmod: Tungsten uses bigint_powmod_any's Montgomery/Barrett window implementation (also validated against an independent naive mirror); Rust uses num-bigint modpow; Odin uses its shipped internal Montgomery/window implementation; odd modulus
methodology.result_lifecycle: immutable APIs compute the next result while the previous one remains live; mutable APIs alternate two destinations
methodology.rust: borrowed operands and ordinary immutable num-bigint results; the previous result stays live until the next is computed
methodology.selection_above_8192_limbs: median elapsed time with interquartile spread
methodology.selection_through_8192_limbs: best elapsed time from all runs
methodology.tungsten: dead result capacity returned to a thread-local power-of-two reserve pool

summary.verdict: verdict: arm64 (Darwin), 25 ops x 1..8192 limbs, one deterministic fixture per cell, mpz_* public API: 446/485 cells < 1.0, geomean 0.625; 60 cells inside the +-5% unresolved band.
